name: Microgrid critical-load restoration request
aliases: microgrids Microgrid black-start and restoration controls
summary: Requests reconnection of the eligible critical load group at its assigned restoration stage.
description: Requests reconnection of the eligible critical load group at its assigned restoration stage. Black-start and restoration control coordinates the establishment of an electrical reference and the gradual return of assigned resources and loads. A dead system, an available starting source and a successful load restoration are distinct states.

In a microgrid recovering from a blackout, an available grid-forming source can establish the assigned island reference before compatible generation and eligible load groups are introduced under the validated restoration strategy. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Critical-load eligibility and reserve” at the input and “Critical-load reconnect request” at the output. The process can have independent restart requirements.
